ScopeName.description: A drawing's scope as `analysis.drawings` names it.

oneOf.description: Every chart of the drawing's market, at any timeframe.
Only the chart it is on, at the bars that chart is cut to.

changed.description: Whether the call moved it; `false` when it already stood there.

pinned_bars.description:
The bar rule (`time:15m`) a drawing kept to its chart shows at; absent
for one shown on all timeframes, and for one saved before drawings
recorded their bars, which shows at every bar rule of its chart.

scope.description: The drawing's scope as it stands after the call.
